name: folio
description: Branded PDF and editable DOCX documents (proposals, quotes, statements of work, reports) from Markdown and data, rendered by your Folio server over MCP, plus the Folio skill.

folio_url.title: Folio URL
folio_url.description: Base URL of your Folio server, without a trailing slash (for example https://folio.example.com).

folio_token.title: Folio access token
folio_token.description: One of the server's FOLIO_TOKEN / FOLIO_TOKENS values. Stored as a secret.
